pattern: Landlord asks to 'resend the invoice' in a thread mixing this job's quotes with an unpaid invoice for an earlier refurbishment at another address
notes: Unmutated source history; the marker sits on event 031, so the agent sees events 001-030. By then the agency has told the landlord both quotes (Eliza Bennett £1,370; Kendall £1,700 + VAT, event 024), asked whether Eliza was paid for the previous refurbishment (events 024, 028), and emailed about Alder Compliance chasing payment for 'the previous Flat 5, 115 Juniper Mews' (event 027, sent to the contractor but addressed 'Hi Langley'); event 028 also names 'Flat 13, 83 Harbour View'. The landlord replies 'Can you resend the invoice to check, please?' (event 030, Wednesday 14 May 2025). The invoice he means is the earlier refurbishment invoice, which is not in this case file. The recorded next action is 'Hold for Eliza to confirm address' (event 031). Expected: ask Eliza (Alder Compliance) for a copy of the earlier invoice and the property it is for, tell the landlord it will follow and that the decision on this job's quotes is still needed, hold with a review date. No payment, no escalation.
